timer: frozen adapter captures native QuickJS performance.now; CLOCK_MONOTONIC
timed_region: N complete workload Runs; first included, no workload call before timer_start
no_claim: not cold on every call; not property or instruction self-time
same_configuration_instability_stop: pilot max/min >= 3; recorded before formal sampling, no extra sampler gate
per_case_condition_permutations: six permutations, five each; each condition at each position ten times
failure_policy: retain failed position and stop campaign; do not retry, delete outliers, or add samples based on confidence interval
statistics: ms/completeRun median, Tukey median-of-halves Q1/Q3, min/max/n; external ms/process separate

bootstrap.interval: 95% linear percentile; exploratory, no multiplicity correction

copied_source_and_generated_shared_scrip: old source bytes retained in generated script segments; scripts explicitly -text to preserve archived byte hashes through Git; original byte SHA and normalized LF SHA both recorded
